name: sparx — Nail Studio (Gallery)
tagline: A gallery-chic template for nail studios — book online from day one.
description: A gallery-chic nail-studio site — a clean gallery-cream palette, a coral-rose primary and a deep-teal accent under a crisp grotesque display, with the nail-art photography carrying the page. Installs a working booking flow: a real menu (manicures, gel, builder-gel, pedicures, art, removal), three artists you book by name, and two shared nail stations a manicure consumes alongside its artist. Ships as "Lacquer", a calm daylight studio.
